about_the_game:
Rail Defence: Eldritch Siege is a tower defense roguelike where battle trains clash with cosmic horrors. In a steampunk world shrouded by the Eldritch God’s malevolent influence, you must craft rail networks, deploy enchanted trains, and upgrade their arcane powers to repel endless minions. Unlock new trains, bases, and relics to shape your strategy and hold the line against the otherworldly trials of the Eldritch God.

Adjust Rails, Automate Combat

Lay down base stations and relays, weaving rails to guide your trains in an endless cycle. As they pass stations, trains unleash arcane barrages on the Eldritch God’s minions. Focus on designing intricate rail defenses—combat is automated, but victory demands strategic mastery.

Build Trains, Defend Your Base

Unlock an array of trains and bases, each with distinct upgrades. Combine trains to unlock devastating synergies. Strengthen your fleet to endure relentless assaults from eldritch horrors. Survive the onslaught, and confront the final trial of the Eldritch God in a battle for humanity’s survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Windows 10 64bit
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 or higer
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Command battle trains in Rail Defence: Eldritch Siege! Face the Eldritch God's trials, fend off waves of minions, and build unbreakable rail defenses. Strategize, upgrade, and fight to protect humanity’s last hope against the cosmic horrors!
